title: Date format lab
description: Format instants with strftime patterns and Intl.DateTimeFormat options side by side, and check the outputs.
needs: one or more instant parts (a tdata Instant or an ISO string) and one or more strftime ({format}) or intl ({locale, options}) parts
query: [.messages[] ~ {kind: "instant"}] as $instants | [.messages[] ~ {kind: "strftime"}] as $strftimes | [.messages[] ~ {kind: "intl"}] as $intls | ($instants | length) > 0 and (($strftimes | length) > 0 or ($intls | length) > 0)
